notes: Inland Revenue: fine metal (gold >=99.5%, silver >=99.9%) is a GST-exempt supply; jewellery is taxable at 15% GST. Bar premium removed in round 4 (spot was the selling shop own site, not primary). Used 10% removed: a guaranteed floor (at least 90% of melt), not a typical discount. Duty not verified officially, null. 9ct most popular; 18ct fine standard.

sources.name: Inland Revenue - Exempt supplies (fine metal)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the sale of fine metal (gold >=99.5%, silver >=99.9% fine) by a dealer or importer is an exempt supply for GST
sources.quote: The sale of fine metal by a dealer, or anyone importing fine metal is an exempt supply.

sources.name: Inland Revenue - Charging GST
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: GST-registered sellers charge GST at 15% on most taxable supplies (jewellery is not fine metal)
sources.quote: If you're registered for GST, you'll need to charge GST at 15% on most taxable supplies you make.
